svg.title: SceneColor: before diffuse-indirect composite
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. SceneColor: before diffuse-indirect composite graph 0001 | pass RenderLight Light::StandardDeferred: Ceiling area light | one shared SceneColor transform linear radiance: shared exposure 0.384589, Reinhard, sRGB valid zero radiance (black) non-finite (yellow) Both SceneColor before/after figures use one declared exposure, normalization and OETF: Both SceneColor versions use exactly this transform; no independent percentile, exposure or tone curve is applied to either version.. exposure = 0.384588805461 (1 / shared p99 luminance 2.600179687500), then c/(1+c), then sRGB OETF. The same constants are applied to both versions. SceneColor is linear HDR radiance in engine render-target units; no absolute photometric calibration is claimed.
